# Security Requirements Checklist: Candidate Route Baseline and Role Contracts

**Purpose**: Assess whether hard role boundaries, candidate exclusion, sanitized evidence, mutation prohibitions, and route-to-contract integrity are complete, clear, consistent, and reviewable.
**Created**: 2026-07-14
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Hard Contract Preservation

- [x] CHK001 Are role and authorization boundaries explicitly required for every named agent rather than inferred from its route or model? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006; Data Model §AgentContract]
- [x] CHK002 Are approval conditions and authorized approvers explicitly included within the hashed authorization boundary? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006; Data Model §AgentContract]
- [x] CHK003 Are safety and grounding requirements defined as hard contract fields for all twelve agents? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006; Contract §Agent record]
- [x] CHK004 Are mutation restrictions required to state permitted and prohibited behavior plus stop or escalation conditions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006; Data Model §AgentContract]
- [x] CHK005 Are tool, skill, and MCP requirements required to preserve restrictions rather than merely list available capabilities? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006; Contract §Agent record]
- [x] CHK006 Are sandbox expectations and output contracts explicit hard boundaries for every agent? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006; Data Model §AgentContract]
- [x] CHK007 Are supported-client assumptions and representative tasks kept in the same semantic contract without weakening the hard fields? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006; Data Model §AgentContract]
- [x] CHK008 Do parity-role mappings cover every semantic field, preserve the mapped value in the contract hash, and force `no_go` on a missing or inconsistent hard field? [Measurability, Spec §FR-007; Data Model §SemanticMapping]

## Candidate Exclusion and Route Integrity

- [x] CHK009 Must every candidate bind to the enclosing agent contract ID and contract hash? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010; Data Model §CandidateRoute]
- [x] CHK010 Must every present production route bind to the enclosing agent contract hash? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010; Data Model §ProductionRoute]
- [x] CHK011 Are model, effort, and treatment changes prohibited from replacing or relaxing the bound hard contract? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010; Contract §Agent record]
- [x] CHK012 Does an evidenced hard role, authorization or approval, safety, grounding, mutation, tool, skill, MCP, sandbox, or output incompatibility require exclusion? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012; Data Model §Incompatibility]
- [x] CHK013 Must every exclusion cite evidence and the affected contract field while local unavailability remains insufficient? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012–FR-013; Contract §Candidate and policy bounds]
- [x] CHK014 Are candidate capability requirements independently defined for model, modalities, effort, custom agents, tools, skills, MCP, sandbox, mutation, and clients? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010; Data Model §CapabilityRequirements]
- [x] CHK015 Are project eligibility, installation availability, qualification, preference, and fallback ordering kept as distinct states? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013 and §FR-015; Data Model §CandidateRoute]
- [x] CHK016 Are unchanged-treatment controls and evidence-backed variant hypotheses required without allowing treatment changes to redefine authorization or mutation policy? [Scenario Coverage, Spec §FR-014 and §FR-010]

## Evidence Sanitization and Grounding

- [x] CHK017 Are platform facts restricted to official OpenAI sources and project facts to pinned tracked repository evidence? [Grounding, Spec §FR-016–FR-017]
- [x] CHK018 Are facts, inferences, proposed policy, assumptions, environment observations, and conflicts visibly classified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018–FR-019; Data Model §ProvenanceRecord]
- [x] CHK019 Are tracked, cached, and installed observations independent, with local state prohibited from redefining the production contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005; Data Model §SourceObservation]
- [x] CHK020 Are retained cache and installed locators logical only, with absolute/home paths, usernames, hostnames, credentials, secrets, and unrelated configuration prohibited? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021; Contract §Evidence and surfaces]
- [x] CHK021 Are surface-specific claims prevented from inheriting across CLI, desktop app, app server, and non-interactive contexts? [Coverage, Spec §FR-020; Data Model §SurfaceRecord]
- [x] CHK022 Must stale, unavailable, unverifiable, conflicting, or invalidated evidence stop supporting a fact or passing gate until revalidated or reclassified? [Exception Coverage, Spec §FR-017–FR-019]

## Mutation and Scope Isolation

- [x] CHK023 Is this spike normatively prohibited from mutating tracked source, agents, prompts, installers, caches, installed state, generated payloads, defaults, versions, or unrelated configuration? [Completeness, Spec §Scope Boundaries and §FR-027]
- [x] CHK024 Are discovered source, cache, install, payload, or configuration defects record-only findings rather than authority to repair them? [Scenario Coverage, Spec §Scope Boundaries; Plan §Design Decisions]
- [x] CHK025 Are runtime probing, live scoring, qualification, and final route ordering explicitly outside this security boundary? [Consistency, Spec §FR-027; Contract §Purpose]
- [x] CHK026 Is the delivery file set closed and all production, plugin, installer, payload, cache, route, and default surfaces declared read-only? [Measurability, Plan §Declared File Operations and §Project Structure]

## Review, Handoff, and Acceptance Quality

- [x] CHK027 Do changes to any hard boundary, hash input, route-to-contract binding, hard-incompatibility rule, or eligibility/availability semantics require explicit maintainer security review? [Coverage, Spec §Clarifications Session 2]
- [x] CHK028 Does the focused checker contract fail on route-to-contract drift, an evidenced hard-incompatible candidate remaining eligible, sanitization violations, and eligibility/availability conflation? [Acceptance Criteria, Plan §Evidence and Validation Design; Contract §Checker contract]
- [x] CHK029 Does `go` require passing contract, candidate, provenance, agreement, sanitization, conflict, and classified-unknown checks before the deadline? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024–FR-025; Data Model §HandoffDecision]
- [x] CHK030 Does G56R-002 admission preserve candidate eligibility and immutable route/contract/candidate identities rather than silently rewriting security boundaries? [Consistency, Spec §FR-023–FR-024; Contract §Unknowns and handoff]
- [x] CHK031 Does any upstream identity or contract drift invalidate admission and dependent results until explicit re-admission? [Recovery Coverage, Spec §FR-024; Data Model §HandoffDecision]
- [x] CHK032 Can a PR reviewer trace every preserved hard boundary, exclusion, sanitization rule, mutation prohibition, and handoff guard to a normative requirement without undocumented judgment? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003–SC-009; Plan §Requirement and Acceptance Traceability]

## Notes

- Initial assessment found four security requirement gaps: approval was implicit; mandatory hard-incompatibility exclusion did not enumerate skill and MCP boundaries; route tuple changes were not expressly barred from rebinding the hard contract; and the normative mutation/review rules did not enumerate every protected surface and boundary. These were resolved through requirements-only clarifications before this single re-assessment.
- Re-assessment result: 32 of 32 items satisfied; zero unresolved gap markers and zero security-consensus items.
- Check items off as completed: `[x]`.
- This checklist assesses requirements writing for a PR reviewer; it does not test implementation, add platform facts, execute candidates, or authorize mutation.
